continuous.semantics: independent admissible control at every physical interval

finite.semantics: independent catalog choice at every interval; distinct task from continuous control

objective.evaluation: terminal expression plus every physical running term divided by original interval count; never renormalize a shrinking tail

prediction.discretization: per-stage matrix exponential; source-specific LV Taylor offset or fuel endpoint-matched offset
prediction.validity: numerical local/frozen predictor only; no nonlinear enclosure or off-reference error bound

roles.off_trajectory_policy_queries: any state in the declared model domain and physical state bounds; do not restrict to recorded nominal trajectory

off_trajectory_query_fixtures.purpose: off-nominal policy query away from initial state
